preservedResponsibilities: S3HW1E connects native RTF lang/alang/langfe through saved RTFParserState run types, LanguageTag numeric-to-BCP47 conversion, real nested RTFSprms, DomainMapper Locale properties, typed UNO Locale transport and original SvxLanguageItem conversion. LANG-before-text paragraph properties are captured at checkNeedPap emission with owned snapshots, preserving nested-group and later-run order; plain/paragraph resets and empty paragraphs are tested. Source-derived pseudo character runs split actual export at script/bidi boundaries and feed RTLAndCJKState; for this direction-less Writer paragraph profile the caller explicitly supplies the pinned Environment pool default, not guessed text/locale direction. Native single-empty-run output omits braces. Deflang/adeflang zero-child nesting remains as upstream (WRITER251). Actual mixed-script and Markdown/Worker/RTF round-trips pass. Generic layout-direction/frame owners, fields and full RTF/OOXML/ABI parity are not claimed; all broad parity confidence remains unverified.
The text language state contributes to the current body or shape text append scope.
omittedResponsibilities: Only the consumed language value responsibility is mapped here; unrelated numeric dispatch remains on its existing owners. No whole-module/compiled ABI claim.
